approaches_tried.approach: First live --next-batch invocation against the real 152-task specs/state.json, immediately after the first redeploy
approaches_tried.reason: silent exit 1, zero stdout/stderr, no documented exit code -- root-caused to a set -e footgun in build_ready_set()'s final `[ "$all_ok" = true ] && READY_SET[...]=1` line, triggered because the real state.json's highest-numbered active task (644) sorts last and has an unmet dependency (all_ok=false). Fixed with an explicit if/then, added regression case (s), redeployed again, re-ran the live invocation successfully.

deviations.description: Run deploy-headless.sh; invoke the deployed suggester live and confirm the ACCEPTANCE sentence
deviations.reason: The first live invocation (after the first redeploy) crashed silently -- a latent set -e footgun inherited verbatim from the pre-refactor build_ready_pool() one-liner, exposed only because Phase 2's READY_SET-persistence fix requires build_ready_set() to run directly in the caller's shell rather than inside an insulating process-substitution subshell. Fixed in orchestrate-suggest-next-batch.sh, added regression case (s) to the test suite (a declared scope excursion, see issue log), re-ran the full source-store suite (27/27 green), redeployed a second time, and re-ran the live invocation successfully.
